product.name: Anima Design-to-Code Platform
product.description: A platform that converts Figma designs into production-ready code including React, HTML, Vue, and CSS, enabling rapid prototyping and development.

product.name: Anima Frontier
product.description: An AI-powered front-end coding assistant in VSCode that converts Figma designs into React code using existing codebases and design system components.

product.name: Anima API
product.description: An API that converts Figma design links into pixel-perfect, runnable code packages for integration with vibe coding platforms and AI coding agents.

product.name: Figma to HTML Email Conversion
product.description: A tool that converts Figma email designs into responsive, email-client compatible HTML with inline CSS.

identifier.value: Figma to UI Library Components Conversion

product.name: Figma to UI Library Components Conversion
product.description: A feature that generates clean, responsive code for UI libraries like Material UI, Ant Design, and shadcn from Figma designs.

identifier.value: Live Website and Web Application Builder from Figma
